name: coordination/refusal-consent-required
description: `dispatch` without live consent (ADR-0016 §3). The same `409` whether the receipt was never minted, is malformed, or belongs to a different staged digest — a driver may hold a receipt it was given, and it learns nothing about receipts it does not hold. Minting one is admin's alone, so this is the wall a compromised driver hits: it can burn consent it was handed, never create it.

problem.title: no live consent receipt binds that staged digest
